Subject: Re: Latency & 5xx spike this morning — urgent

Sarah — thank you for the fast report and logs. We're on it. Initial read of the traces suggests head-of-line (HOL) blocking in the KV-prefetch path: a small percentage of requests are acquiring a batching lock for a large prefix and holding it while waiting on remote KV fill/eviction, which serializes subsequent requests in the same batch lane. That leads to burst pacing, queue buildup, and eventually request timeouts.

Immediate actions I will run now:
- Disable aggressive lane coalescing for FinTechCo's tenant (10m rollback window).
- Enable model fallback to a smaller-quantized variant for heavy tails to reduce per-token latency while we debug.
- Add a temporary per-tenant concurrency cap to limit queue depth and force backpressure earlier.

Rishi / Marissa: can you validate whether the KV eviction tuner was pushed yesterday and whether any prefetch policy changes landed in the last deploy? I will also start a capture of hot prefixes. I'll update you within 30 minutes with a mitigation plan.

-Lukas
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

On Mon, Feb 27, 2028 at 7:26 PM Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Rishi / Marissa: can you validate whether the KV eviction tuner was pushed yesterday and whether any prefetch policy changes landed in the last deploy?

Checked deploy changelog and config diff: we rolled a tweak to the prefix prefetch heuristic yesterday (reduce RTT threshold for async prefetch), and an automatic lane coalescing change that groups small keys into the same batch lane to improve utilization. That coalescing looks like the likely root cause here when combined with a bad eviction threshold on a few hot shards. The grouped lane holds the batch lock while waiting for eviction+remote fill -> serializes others.

I pushed a quick hotfix to turn off lane coalescing for the affected region and reverted the prefetch RTT change for FinTechCo's tenant. I've also opened a metrics dashboard that isolates per-prefix lock-hold time and queue depth.

Marissa: can you coordinate a canary rollback for the small KV policy change? We should also keep Sarah informed about the expected window for improvement and any residual risk.

-Rishi
Principal Infra Engineer
